text:
I sat at my desk and chewed on my pencil. Mr. Brown was teaching us math but I was tired. I feared I got the last answer wrong. Suddenly, my juice box squirted on my shirt. It made a big purple stain right on my belly.

"Oh no, look at your shirt!" whispered Jenny.

"I know, my mom will be mad," I said back.

Then the bell rang and we ran outside for recess. We played tag and I ran super fast. I was training for the big race next week. I knew I could win if I tried hard. We sang a silly song while we played. Then Mr. Brown blew his whistle loudly. He taught us that the whistle means stop. I was earning a gold star for being good today.

It was my big brother Mike’s birthday party. He turned thirteen today and he was acting super cool. Mom was wearing a funny hat and coaching Dad on the grill. The smoke was approaching the patio table so we moved.

"Open my present first!" yelled my friend Leo.

Mike ripped the paper with some scissors. It was a new game for his computer. He smiled big and then he looked at the cake. My little sister started stamping her feet because she wanted cake now.

"Stop that right now," Mom said to her.

Suddenly a big breeze scattered all the napkins everywhere. We all ran to catch them before they flew away. My aunt said she almost fainted from running so fast. We ate cake and then Mike let me climb the big tree. It was the best day ever and I want to do it again.

My nephew Ben and I went to the park. We wanted to find the greatest tree to climb. We saw a big oak tree with low branches.

"I bet I can climb to that height!" said Ben.

He grasped the rough bark and pulled himself up. I followed him up the big, strong trunk. It felt good to use our imagination outside. We pretended we were monkeys in the jungle. Suddenly, a blue bird flew right past my head!

"Did you see that bird?" I asked loudly.

We climbed higher but we were careful about our weight. We finally sat on a branch and looked down. We felt like we won a big game. That night, I slept really well because I was tired. Exploring is the best thing to do.

I was thrilled because today was the big soccer game. My dad was coaching our team and he made a schedule for everyone. We went to the huge building where the indoor field is. I put on my cleats and realized my shoelace snapped like a knife cut it!

"Oh no, I can't play like this!" I yelled.

My dad said simply, "Don't worry, just use this extra lace."

I fixed it and ran onto the field. The other team was dumping water on their heads. They looked scary. But then I got the ball and escaped past two defenders. I kicked it hard and it hit the ceiling! Everyone started groaning. But the ref said play on. I followed the ball and kicked it again. Goal! It felt like a huge weight was off me. I can’t wait to write about this at school.

I was reading a book about space when my computer started thumping. It sounded like a giant heart beating inside the screen. Suddenly a green alien crawled out of the monitor. He was small and trembling with fear. He looked like a tiny sailor but with three eyes.

"Please help me!" the alien squeaked loudly.

"What is wrong?" I asked him quickly.

He said a robot was chasing him through the wires. We ran to the garden fountain and hid behind it. The scary robot came out next, but he slipped on wet grass. He fell in the water and started swearing in robot beeps. It was funny even though we were scared. That was enough adventure for one day. I am earning a medal for saving an alien. Although, my mom will be mad about the wet computer.

One day I walked to school and felt a cool breeze. It was a weird day because the bus was late. I looked at the scenery while I waited a bit longer. Finally the bus came and I had to squeeze inside.

At lunch, the cafeteria lady gave us stewed tomatoes. They looked gross so I did not eat them. My friend Sam said, "I am scared to try it."

I laughed and said, "I knew you would say that!"

Then the bell started ringing so we ran to class. I forgot my homework but my teacher was nice. She let me bring it tomorrow instead. School is fun but sometimes lunch is bad.

My nephew Sam and I walked straight into the dark woods. We were leaving home to find the lost gold. Suddenly, a monkey jumped down like a bungee cord! It screeched loud and stuck out its pink tongue.

"Run away fast!" I yelled at Sam.

We sprinted through the mud because it started raining hard. My heart was beating super fast in my chest. We used all our strength to climb a big rock. Sam found a piece of paper on the ground. It was an old receipt for pizza!

"I am so hungry now," Sam said sadly.

We didn't find gold, but we went home and ate stewed apples. It was a scary adventure but we were safe.

I had a big test today in math class. Mrs. Jones said we had to write all the answers fast. My hands gripped the pencil tight and I was scared. I counted my fingers to help with the hard problems. Then the bell screeched really loud and everyone jumped up.

"Did you finish enough problems?" my friend Sam asked me.

"I think so," I said. "I obtained the last answer just in time."

At recess, we ran to the playground and reached the monkey bars. We pretended the bars were a giant castle in the sky. My papers scattered out of my pocket, but Sam helped me. I was grateful he is my best friend. We played until the teacher told us to explain the meaning of subtraction. It was a pretty good day.

Yesterday was the big race at school. I sat on the bench and my legs were trembling. I knew I had to run fast. My friend Sam drank a soda with caffeine. He said it meant he would win the race.

"You aren't fast enough," Sam laughed at me.

"I will beat you," I shouted back loudly.

The teacher blew the whistle and we all sprinted. I pushed my legs hard and ran very fast. Although Sam was fast, I pulled ahead at the end. I won the race and felt great! My dad put my picture in the school newspaper. Tomorrow I will race again but I won't lose either.

I was cleaning my desk at school today. Suddenly, a huge black beetle appeared right on my pencil case! I blew on it, but it was stronger than me. It just held on tight and did not move a single inch.

"Ew, get it away!" yelled my friend Sarah.

"I think it wants to learn math," I said.

The beetle crawled straight across my ruler. Maybe it wanted to measure how long it was. Then the bell rang for recess. We ran out the door and through the hallway to the water fountain. When we came back, the beetle had disappeared. It was the greatest mystery ever. My teacher said it probably grew wings and flew home.

My dog Buster thinks he is a brave knight. We went outside today because it was not freezing. Buster saw a squirrel on the fence. He ran fast and drew a line in the dirt.

"Get down here!" I yelled at the squirrel.

The squirrel was clinging to the wood like a bug. It looked at me like a tiny sailor steering a ship. Buster jumped up, bringing his paws on the fence. He scrambled to get higher but he fell down.

"Try again, Buster," I said.

He has good strength but the squirrel was too high. It looked like it was hiding a jewel in its cheeks. We had to go inside because of my school schedule. Buster was sad but I gave him a treat. He is still my best friend even if he can't catch squirrels.

My friends and I walked into the dark woods. We were looking for the lost pirate treasure. Ben had a map spread out in his hands. He pointed at a big red X.

"We need to find the old tree," said Ben.

We walked for a long time. Suddenly, we saw a huge wall. It was closed and locked tight. I saw a tiny thread hanging from a rock. I pulled it and the gate bounced open!

"Wow, you are so strong!" yelled Sarah.

We started jumping over the rocks and climbing up the hill. At the top, we saw a shiny gold box. It was enough gold for everyone! We were so happy we found the treasure.

My papers were scattered all over my messy desk. I looked at the clock and sighed really loud. My schedule said it was time for art class. I grabbed my pencil case and ran to the door.

My friend Leo was waiting for me in the hallway. "Do you want some company?" he asked me.

"Yes please," I said and we walked together.

In art class, we drew giant monsters with green teeth. I obtained the best blue marker from the bin. I grasped it tight and colored the sky. Then the bell rang for lunch and I grinned. I had to complete my drawing later. I was so hungry for pizza day!

One day I was walking on a huge mountain. I saw a shiny robot sitting on a rock. His metal leg was all twisted up. I walked over to him slowly.

"Are you okay?" I asked the robot.

"My leg is stuck," the robot said sadly.

I grasped his leg and pulled hard. I pulled and pulled. Gradually it came loose. The robot stood up and beeped. He had a big oil stain on his chest. We crossed the bumpy rocks together. Throughout the day we walked home. I was certain we were best friends now.

"Thank you for helping me," he said.

Then he flew away into the sky!

I was in my backyard when a spaceship crashed. It made a loud noise and I was scared. A green alien climbed out and he was short in height. He had three eyes and looked very weird.

"Do you understand me?" the alien asked loudly.

I nodded my head and I felt nervous. He said his name was Zog and he liked science. Zog pulled a weird bar from his pocket.

"This is space protein," he said and took a bite.

He kept chewing and then he started stamping his feet. Suddenly a robot daughter came out of the ship too. She was shiny and she gave my hand a squeeze. I used my imagination and we played tag all day. I met two new friends and it was not a failure. I liked seeing them fly away back home.

My cat Fluffy was sick and making weird sounds. His breathing was very loud and it sounded like thumping.

"Is he okay?" my little nephew asked me scared.

"I think he has pneumonia or a bad cold," I said.

We understood that he needed to go to the vet fast. We put him in his box and drove through town. The vet gave him a shot and I counted his heartbeats. Later at home we brewed some warm milk for his breakfast. He drank it all up and looked happy again.

"Look, he stole my toast!" my nephew yelled and laughed.

The vet gave us a long receipt for the medicine. I am glad Fluffy is better now and playing.

Everyone in my class was growing very tired. We were trapped inside for math class forever. I was looking out the window and yearning for recess. The clock neared twelve and my legs were trembling. I just wanted to be jumping outside with my friends.

"Is it time yet?" I whispered to Sam.

"Five more minutes," he whispered back.

The teacher kept talking but I gripped my pencil hard. A blue vein popped out on my hand. Finally, the loud bell screeched! We all jumped up fast. We ran outside and discovered a big mud puddle. We played for a long time but it felt short. I wish recess was longer so we could receive more fun.

Me and my dog Sparky went into the woods yesterday. The weather was nice and sunny. We walked for a long time until we saw a cave.

"Look at that big hole!" I said to Sparky.

Sparky barked and pulled on his leash really hard. We went inside and it was dark. The earth smelled like wet dirt. Suddenly, Sparky disappeared into the shadows. I was scared but I walked faster.

I saw a big rock and Sparky was digging. He found an old box. I put my finger on the lock. It opened! Inside was a newspaper from a long time ago. I thought I was dreaming.

"We won the treasure hunt!" I yelled.

Sparky stuck out his tongue and licked my face. We slept very good that night because of our big adventure. It really happened!

My friends came over for a sleepover last night. We played outside in the meadow behind my house. It was getting dark and the grass was growing tall.

"I am the captain of this ship!" shouted Billy. He was wearing a big red hat.

"No, I am the captain!" said Sarah.

We pretended there was an elephant chasing us. It was invisible so we could not see it either. We ran fast because we did not want trouble. Then we fell down like there was no gravity. It felt like heaven looking at the stars. My mom called us inside for pizza. We had to maintain a quiet volume inside. I love earning extra dessert for being good.

My family went boating on a big lake for my birthday. We felt like real sailors on the water. My dad packed us sandwiches with lots of protein. He said, "You need energy for swimming later."

Then I saw a huge black beetle on my seat! It was just roaming around my life jacket. I got scared and I squeezed my eyes shut tight. My sister laughed and she crossed the boat to help me. She put the beetle in a cup so it was trapped. But then she spilled her soda and made a big stain. Mom said, "I knew you had too much caffeine today!" We jumped in the water to wash it off. It was the best birthday ever.

My dad was coaching my soccer team after school. But first I had to eat my lunch. I sat down on the cold bench. It was freezing outside! I opened my lunchbox and saw a plain cheese sandwich.

"Oh no," I said. "This is so boring."

Then my friend Tim crashed into me. He was dumping his juice out. It made a huge orange stain on my shirt. I stood up and started moaning about my shirt.

"Sorry!" Tim yelled. "I was trapped by the big kids."

I had to write a note to my mom about the mess. Later we went camping in the backyard. It was way better than school. I hope my dad doesn't have a meeting tomorrow so we can play again.

It was my friend Sam’s birthday and we had a sleepover. We were in the backyard and the breeze felt nice. Sam has a big treehouse and we climbed up the ladder. It looked like an island in the sky.

"Look at that sign," said Sam, pointing at a bird.

We saw a blue jay building a nest in the branches. It was keeping very quiet. Then Sam pushed the tire swing and started swinging. He looked happy. Later, his dad came out with a big brown guitar. He played a funny song and we clapped.

"That was incredible!" I yelled.

Sam caught a firefly in a jar but let it go. We didn’t see a single mosquito all night. It was the best sleepover ever.

Me and my friend Sam found a map in an old newspaper. It had a weird design on it. We crossed the big bridge near the park. A mean dog was the guard at the gate. It started swearing at us with loud barks.

"Run fast!" I yelled.

We ran for an hour until the dog disappeared. The map led us to a cave. We had to do some cleaning to get inside. I twisted my ankle on a rock. Sam helped me up. He drew a stick sword for protection.

"Look at that heavy chest," Sam said.

We pushed the weight off the top. Inside was just old rocks. We felt sad but at least we didn't have to get paid to have fun. It was the best adventure ever.

I was playing my favorite video game called Super Climber. My character was a sailor wearing a blue hat. He had to climb a big mountain to win. I played for thirteen minutes and I kept falling down.

"You need to use the scissors item!" said my brother.

"I can’t find them anywhere," I yelled back.

Then I discovered a hidden cave behind a rock. I bounced inside and found the shiny scissors. I used them to cut the ropes. The big boss fainted when he saw me. I did a search for the treasure chest. It was a meeting place for all the winners. I finally won the game!

I sat in my chair and looked out the window. The scenery outside was very nice and sunny. We were supposed to learn about maps today. My teacher Mrs. Green held up a big globe of the earth.

"Who knows where the ocean is?" asked Mrs. Green.

"I know because I went boating once!" said Timmy.

Then it was time for art class. I got my scissors and cut some blue paper. I was making a picture of the sky. Suddenly I smelled something funny.

"Who is eating lunch early?" I asked my friend.

It smelled like a toasted cheese sandwich. I was so hungry that I almost slept in class. Finally the bell rang for recess and we all ran outside. It was the best part of the whole day.

It was raining outside so recess was inside today. I was certain that meant we had to read books. But Mrs. Miller had a surprise for us. She was bringing out the big box of LEGOs! Everyone yelled and my heart started thumping fast.

"You have twenty minutes to complete a tower," she said.

I grabbed red blocks and my friend Sam grabbed blue ones. Our tower grew very tall gradually. I put my finger on the top piece. Suddenly, a paper airplane flew across the room and hit it!

"Oh no!" Sam shouted. "It broke!"

The tower crashed down. We looked at the clock approaching lunch time. We didn't finish, but at least we smelled roasted chicken from the cafeteria. It was still a good day.

Yesterday something funny happened in my math class. Mrs. Green was wearing a bright blue dress. She was writing important numbers on the board. Suddenly, a big bird flew right into our room!

It looked like a foreign bird with red feathers. It flew up high and crashed into the ceiling.

"Oh no!" yelled Mrs. Green. "Everyone stay in your seats!"

The bird flew around in circles and looked scared. I was yearning for it to fly outside. Finally, it crossed the room and zoomed out the window. We all cheered really loud. It was the best math class ever.

It was my birthday sleepover and I was so excited. My mom greeted everyone at the door with pizza. We ran to the basement and counted all the presents. My neighbor came over too and he brought his dog. The dog started thumping his tail on the floor loudly. "He is freezing," said my friend Sam. "No, he just wants food," I said laughing.

We chose a scary movie but found it was boring. We started jumping on the bed instead. My dad yelled, "Stop that thumping right now!" We were keeping him awake with all the noise. We toasted marshmallows in the fireplace later. I ate ten of them and felt sick. My stomach was groaning like a monster. My mom said I had too much sugar and caffeine. I felt like a champion though because I stayed up late. I could feel the blood in my vein pumping fast. It was the best night ever.

I was playing basketball with my friend Sam outside. The sun lit up the court and there was a nice breeze. We were following the rules, but Sam is really good. He bounced the ball fast and it made a loud noise.

"I bet you can't make this shot," Sam yelled.

"It is not impossible," I said back to him.

I held the ball and felt its heavy weight. I chewed my lip because I was nervous. Then I threw it high. It went right in! It was amazing seeing it go through the net. The next day, my dad read the newspaper. He said I scored eight points total. I felt happy because we met at the park and I won.

I was playing soccer in the park with my friends. We were running very fast and kicking the ball hard. My dad was coaching us and yelling from the side. Suddenly, I discovered a big hole in the grass. I fell down and my shoe went flying off. It looked like an invisible monster grabbed my foot.

"Are you okay?" asked my friend Sam.

I got up and saw my shoe hanging from a tree branch. Everyone started laughing at me, but I laughed too. Then the referee blew his loud whistle to stop the game.

"What happened to your shoe?" the referee asked me.

I hopped over to get it, but a dog started to gnaw on it. I almost fainted because it was my favorite lucky shoe! We chased the dog, but he was too fast for us. We ended up just painting our faces and eating pizza instead.

We had art class today and it was super messy. I chose the red paint but then I spilled it. My teacher Mr. Clark saw me and he looked mad. "Who made this big mess?" he asked very loudly. I thought I was in trouble but then Jenny helped me. She cleared the table and got some paper towels for me. We used scissors to cut the wet paper off the table.

Then it was lunch time and I sat with Jenny. She had a juice box but I had just water. My mom says caffeine is bad for kids my age. We talked about the school play about a brave knight. Jenny wants to be the knight but I want the dragon. "Being the dragon is impossible," Jenny said with a laugh. I caught the ball at recess and threw it eight times. I like Jenny’s company because she is funny and nice.

I was walking in the woods with my best friend Sam. We saw a big, dark building behind some bushes. It looked scary but we went inside anyway. There was a sign on the door that said "Keep Out."

"Do you hear that noise?" Sam asked me.

It sounded like someone playing a guitar in the basement. We walked down the stairs carefully. The air was misty and it felt like we were floating. Suddenly, a giant rat jumped out! I threw a crumb of my sandwich at it. The rat ate it and ran away.

"That was close!" I yelled.

We found a magic fountain in the corner. The water was bright blue. We roasted marshmallows on a little fire nearby. My backpack felt heavy with the weight of gold coins we found. It was the best adventure ever.

My dog Buster is meant to be a good boy. Yesterday I threw his favorite red ball over the fence. Buster sprinted fast and crossed into the neighbor's yard. I gripped the fence but I was too short.

"Come back here, Buster!" I yelled really loud.

Buster did not listen and he ran through the bushes. My neighbor Mr. Jones drove up in his big truck. He searched his yard and reached for Buster’s collar.

"I counted to three and he stopped," Mr. Jones said.

He was coaching Buster to sit down nicely. I drew a picture of Buster later. I am glad gravity keeps my dog on the ground. Next time I will hold his leash tight.

My friends and I went to the old forest to search for treasure. We found a small trail and followed it deep into the woods. The trees were tall and scary, but we were not afraid.

Suddenly, we heard a loud groaning sound approaching us.

"Did you hear that noise?" asked Tim with a scared face.

"Maybe it is a bear!" shouted Sarah, and she started to run.

We saw a big shadow, so we had to climb a tree fast. The stinging nettles hurt my legs, but I didn't stop. It wasn't a bear, but it was just a cow. The cow looked at us with anger because we were in its way. We realized we went the wrong way. We jumped down and ran home fast. We never found the gold vein, but at least we were safe.

Me and my best friend Sam went to a scary island. We walked through the dark woods and heard a loud moaning sound. "What was that sound?" asked Sam. I held my plastic knife tight. We saw a giant beetle sleeping on a rock. It looked roasted by the hot sun though. Suddenly a monkey screeched in the trees. We ran fast to a big stone fountain. I heard a knock on the stone. "Look out!" I yelled. A hidden door opened and we jumped inside. We were safe but it was very dark. We hoped we could find the treasure soon.

My nephew Sam and I climbed the big mountain. The wind was freezing and my hands were clinging to rocks. We wanted to find the lost jewel. It belonged to a king from a foreign land.

"I am afraid of the dark cave," said Sam.

"Don't worry, we won't get in trouble," I said.

We heard a loud groaning sound inside. It was scary. We had to squeeze through a tiny hole. Suddenly, I heard a whistle blowing. It was ringing in my ears. We saw the shiny jewel on a stone! I grabbed it fast. We were not a failure today. We ran out and felt grateful to be safe. The king's reign was saved!

I was playing a zombie video game with my nephew. We were trapped in a scary house with zombies roaming around. I had to find a needle to win the level.

"Watch out for that big zombie!" my nephew yelled loudly.

"I see him, don't complain!" I shouted back at him.

I found the needle near a painting on the wall. The painting looked like a boating trip or maybe camping. Suddenly a huge monster crushed the door. He was thirteen feet in height! He almost stole my life points but I ran away fast. I needed some caffeine to stay awake because it was late. Finally, I beat the boss and the game was complete. My mom brought us snacks because we won.

My nephew Sam and I went boating on the lake. We wanted to have a big race with our kayaks. The water was blue and the sun was super hot. We started paddling fast near the long hiking trail. Suddenly Sam disappeared behind a big green bush. I kept paddling and looked for him everywhere. 

"Where are you going?" I yelled loudly across the water.

Sam appeared again and he was smiling really big. "I am winning this race for certain!" he shouted back.

We saw a duck roaming near the water's edge. I was stewed because Sam was faster than me. He won the race and started climbing out. Next time I will paddle faster and win the trophy.

One morning, I woke up really early. The weather was simply perfect for exploring. I opened the back door and ran outside. My dog Max was jumping up and down happily. We went through the tall grass in the backyard. Suddenly, Max stopped and started barking at a big tree.

"What happened, Max?" I asked him loudly.

I looked up and saw something strange growing there. It looked like a big green vein on a leaf. I grasped the branch to see it better. It was just a giant caterpillar! I feared it would bite, but it didn't move.

"He looks different than the other bugs," I said.

My mom says understanding animals is called psychology, but I don't know the meaning. I just like watching them crawl around under the blue ceiling of the sky.

My brother Tom and I were playing a new game. It was a video game about knights and dragons. We had to run through a big stone castle. Tom was leading the way, but I was faster.

"Look out for the trap!" Tom yelled loudly.

I jumped over a spinning knife on the floor. It was a scary scene. We saw a dragon hanging from the ceiling. Neither of us wanted to fight it alone. We kept our hands steady on the controllers.

"We have to do this together," I said.

We pressed the buttons at the same time. The dragon fell down and we won the level. The screen flashed big gold letters. I was finally the champion of the game. We caught our breath and high-fived.

I was sitting in math class and I was so hungry. My stomach made a loud noise like a monster. My neighbor looked at me and laughed. I was dreaming about lunch and eating a giant pizza. Suddenly my pencil disappeared from my desk! It appeared on the floor near the water fountain.

"Can I please go get my pencil?" I asked.

"Yes, but be quick," said Mrs. Green.

I ran over and picked it up. I saw a tiny sailor drawn on the wall. He was holding a map to some treasure. It was so cool seeing that little drawing. Then I felt a sneeze coming. ACHOO! I jumped because it was so loud. I went back to my desk and used my scissors to cut paper. I hope I receive an A on this project. The scenery outside looks nice so I want recess now.

I was painting a picture of a big green alien. I drew him with three eyes and a red sweater. Suddenly the paper started shaking and pumping like a heart.

"What is wrong with my drawing?" I asked loudly.

The alien blinked his three eyes and jumped off the paper! He was stamping his feet on my desk. I realized he was real and I was scared.

"Do you have a jewel?" the tiny alien asked me.

He was the size of a gnat but very loud. I closed my eyes and wished he would go away. I felt something soft like a feather on my hand. When I looked again, he was back in the painting. He was holding a shiny blue jewel and smiling. It was weird but cool.

One day my dog Spot ran out of our apartment. He went to the park because he loves nature. I ran after him very fast. Spot found a big water fountain. He jumped in and got all wet!

"Spot, you are in big trouble!" I yelled.

He just wagged his tail and splashed water everywhere. Then I saw something shiny on a leaf. It was a beautiful green beetle. It was sleeping in the sun. Spot tried to eat it, but I grabbed his collar. Catching him was almost impossible because he was slippery.

"We need to go home for cleaning," I said.

He looked sad but he walked with me. We had an important job to do. We had to get all the mud off his paws.

I went to my nephew Sam’s birthday party early. He is only five and he loves pirates. My dad helped him dress up like a sailor. We played outside and rode our bikes in a chain.

Suddenly, a big dog came approaching us fast! I froze because it looked scary. Sam gripped my arm really tight.

"Don't worry, I will guide you," I said brave.

The dog stopped and started groaning at a squirrel. We ran inside immediately. My uncle was cooking hot dogs. They smelled roasted and good. Then my uncle dropped a plate and said a bad swearing word!

"That sounds different than science class," Sam laughed.

We ate cake and it was the best day ever.

My brother and I played a new video game today. It was a racing game in a big green jungle. I picked the fast red car and he picked the blue truck. The race started and I zoomed down the dusty trail.

"I am going to win this time!" I yelled loudly.

My brother just laughed and chewed his gum. Suddenly a big stinging bee hit my car. It blew up my tire and I spun around. I grabbed the controller tight and tried to fix it. My brother drove past me and opened a secret door. He won the race and I lost again. I almost fainted because I was so mad!

"Good game," he said with a big smile. Next time I will pick the blue truck.

My day at school was the greatest ever! At recess, I climbed on the monkey bars. I pushed my friend Sam on the swings. We ran to the water fountain because we were thirsty.

Then we had a secret meeting by the big tree. Sam showed me a bug he found in the dirt. It was crushed a little bit.

"Look at this giant beetle!" Sam grinned.

I touched its wing, and it felt dry like a newspaper. I had a funny feeling in my tummy.

At lunch, I chewed my sandwich very fast.

"Do you want my cookie?" I asked Sam.

He said yes, and we were best friends again. We played tag until the bell rang. It was a really good day.

I woke up very early today because it was the big soccer game. I was wearing my lucky blue shorts and my special red painting shirt. It was my secret luck charm under my jersey. My brain was thinking about winning the big trophy all morning.

We got to the field and my coach greeted us with a smile. "This is a very important game," he said to the team.

The other team looked huge and I thought winning was impossible. But we started playing and I ran really fast throughout the game. Gradually we got better and better at passing the ball.

Suddenly, the ball came to me and I kicked it super hard! It went right into the goal. "Great job!" my dad yelled from the sideline. We won the game and I was so happy.

My best friend Sam was in the hospital. He broke his leg running too fast. I went to visit him for an hour. I heard a loud knock on his door. His mom greeted me and was bringing snacks. Sam looked sad, but then he saw me.

"Look at this big white cast!" Sam said. "It feels like the weight of an elephant."

I laughed and said, "Maybe we can go boating later."

He smiled gradually. We played cards and ate chips. I was dumping crumbs everywhere on his bed. We pretended the bed was floating in the ocean. The nurse came in to check a vein in his arm. It looked scary but Sam was brave. It was the best visit ever, even if his leg hurt.

It was a hot day and the weather was sunny. My friend Sam came over for a big adventure. We were climbing the biggest hill in the park to race. I thought I could win but Sam is fast. We ran straight up and it was hard work.

"You look like you are in trouble!" Sam yelled.

I did not stop running and I kept going. The height of the hill was really big. Then I saw a single rock in the plain dirt. I jumped over it like a colonel leading an army. It was important to remain fast to win the race.

"I am going to receive the gold medal!" I shouted back.

I won the race and we were both tired. Then we went inside for reading comic books.

Me and my friend Sam went through the dark woods. We feared the big monster but we kept walking. Suddenly a giant bear greeted us with a loud roar!

"Run away fast!" Sam shouted and threw a rock.

The rock hit the ground and the bear looked angry. We scrambled up a tall tree and closed our eyes. I remembered I had some stewed carrots in my pocket. I dropped them and the bear ate them up. The bear disappeared into the bushes and stopped groaning.

"That was scary," I said.

Then we saw a ghost of an old colonel floating by. He looked scorched from a fire. We ran home before it got dark.
